content: If you are allergic to this medication, other azole antifungal agents (such as clotrimazole or fluconazole), or have any other allergies, inform your doctor or pharmacist before using this product. This medication may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. Consult your doctor to determine whether sexual intercourse is safe while using this medication. Be aware that this product may weaken rubber-based contraceptive devices, such as latex condoms, diaphragms, or cervical caps, potentially leading to failure and unintended pregnancy. Avoid using these products during treatment and for three days after completing the treatment. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if absolutely necessary. Discuss the potential risks and benefits with your doctor. Pregnant women should exercise caution when using the vaginal applicator. It is not known whether this medication passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal supplements, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. If someone has overdosed and exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. To prevent vaginal yeast infections, thoroughly dry the genital area after showering, bathing, or swimming. Avoid wearing tight jeans, nylon underwear, pantyhose, wet bathing suits, or damp/sweaty exercise clothes for extended periods. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition. Do not use it for other conditions unless directed by your doctor. If your condition does not improve or recurs within two months, inform your doctor. Store this medication at room temperature. Do not flush it down the toilet or pour it into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your specific health needs.
